request.html:
data [required]

object

Data envelope for updating a Twilio integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to update a Twilio integration account. Every field is optional; only the fields provided are changed. When dataflows is provided, only the dataflow ids included in the request are modified; dataflows omitted from the map keep their current configuration.

authentication

 <oneOf>

Authentication for updating the Twilio integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=basic>

object

Username and password authentication. Only the fields provided are changed; omit password to keep the stored one.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: basic

default: basic

password

string

Secret password or private key.

username

string

Non-secret username or public identifier for the credential pair.

dataflows

object

Dataflows to configure on the Twilio integration account, keyed by dataflow id.

twilio-alerts-logs

object

The Twilio alerts logs dataflow.

enabled

boolean

Whether the Twilio dataflow is enabled.

object

The Twilio call summaries logs dataflow.

enabled

twilio-messages-logs

enabled

boolean

name

string

Human-readable name of the Twilio integration account.

settings

object

Settings for updating the Twilio integration account. Only the fields provided are changed.

account_sid

string

Twilio Account SID that uniquely identifies your Twilio account.

censor_logs

boolean

When enabled, Twilio phone numbers in the to field and SMS message bodies are censored for privacy.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the Twilio integration account to update.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
